data.title: Swiss president to visit Thailand
data.description: Swiss President Guy Parmelin will visit Thailand from Thursday until Saturday to strengthen bilateral ties, promote trade and investment, and discuss regional and international cooperation.

data.title: Southern Thailand braces for heavy rain
data.description: Cooler winds signal Thailand’s transition into the cold season, but heavy rain and possible flash floods remain a concern along the southern Gulf coast, particularly from Oct 23-27, forecasters say.

data.title: IMF chief urges Asean states to do more for the vulnerable
data.description: The International Monetary Fund has urged Southeast Asian governments to protect vulnerable households, pursue economic reforms and deepen regional cooperation to strengthen resilience against global economic shocks.

data.title: Macron: French protesters ‘exploited’ by political forces
data.description: PARIS - French President Emmanuel Macron believes students waging three weeks of protests that have closed many schools have “legitimate” grievances but are also being “exploited” by political forces, a government spokeswoman said on Wednesday.

data.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosque in West Bank
data.description: MIKHMAS, Palestinian Territories - Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque and graffitied its outside walls on Wednesday in the occupied West Bank village of Mikhmas, Palestinian sources and the Israeli military said.

data.title: Global anti-fraud plan unveiled
data.description: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank have unveiled a global roadmap to help countries prevent, detect and tackle the growing threat of cyber-enabled fraud in digital financial services.

data.title: Drone hits data centre of Russia’s largest bank
data.description: MOSCOW - A drone hit a data centre belonging to the Russian state-owned lender Sberbank, a company executive said Wednesday, though the bank’s systems and services were operating normally.

data.title: Pope recovering after lung cancer operation
data.description: ROME - Pope Leo XIV began post-surgery recovery on Wednesday after a tumour removed from his lung was found to be cancerous, plunging the Catholic Church into a period of uncertainty.

data.title: State auditors query Thai PBS contracts
data.description: The State Audit Office (SAO) has expressed suspicions about the way Thai Public Broadcasting Service hires and pays programme producers, saying it is evading payment rules.

data.title: Cities That Win the Future Will Be Built for Life, Not Just Growth
data.description: Leaders from Bangkok, Hong Kong and Copenhagen tell CNN Global Perspectives that talent, visitors and investment follow a city's soul, not its skyline

data.title: Sansiri Capital completes the acquisition of The Lake Como EDITION,
data.description: Sansiri Capital completes the acquisition of “The Lake Como EDITION,” an ultra-luxury hotel on the shores of Lake Como, Italy.

data.title: Indonesian haze causes spike in Singapore pollution
data.description: SINGAPORE - Air pollution in parts of Singapore hit the country’s “very high” band on Wednesday while Timor-Leste shut schools, as haze from forest fires raging in Indonesia causes a regional crisis.

data.title: Generali, World Bank Group partner on insurance, resilience and investment in emerging markets
data.description: Generali and the World Bank Group (WBG) have recently signed a Memorandum of Understanding during the Annual Meetings of the WBG and the International Monetary Fund in Bangkok , built on a shared commitment to mobilise private capital, strengthen resilience and expand targeted insurance and investment solutions across emerging markets.

data.title: Fuel shortage triggers queues on Bali
data.description: DENPASAR, Indonesia - Moldovan tourist Raisa Neagu spent hours on Wednesday waiting to fuel up her scooter, one of many people snared in a petrol shortage on resort island Bali that authorities blamed on supply disruptions.

data.title: Chut Thai on Cusp of UNESCO Recognition as Princess Sirivannavari Champions Living Heritage on World Stage
data.description: Thailand awaits a UNESCO decision as a CNN Global Perspectives panel hails Queen Sirikit's legacy and Princess Sirivannavari's work for Thai craft

data.title: High-water alert at Khlong Luang Phaeng in Bangkok
data.description: Residents living along Khlong Luang Phaeng in eastern Bangkok have been urged to monitor water levels closely after the Royal Irrigation Department agreed to open the canal’s sluice gate, with levels expected to rise starting from 3.30pm on Wednesday.

data.title: Thai Airways offers new help after baggage crisis
data.description: Thai Airways International is stepping up compensation to restore passenger confidence after major flooding disrupted services, leaving 25,000 bags stranded and forcing more than 200 flight cancellations.

data.title: Thai woven bags draw interest at IMF–World Bank 2026
data.description: Souvenir bags made from Khu Bua textiles in Ratchaburi took almost a year to prepare, pairing traditional Thai weaving with contemporary design.

data.title: ibank Unites Global Islamic Finance Leaders to Unlock New Opportunities for Thailand and ASEAN
data.description: The Islamic Bank of Thailand (ibank) convened leaders, financial institution executives, and Islamic finance experts from Thailand and abroad at the international forum “Islamic Finance: From Crisis Resilience to Transition Finance.” Building on Thailand’s hosting theme, “Thailand’s New Horizons: Empowering People, Building Resilience,” the forum explored how Islamic finance can strengthen economic resilience, mobilize capital for sustainable transitions, and unlock new opportunities for Thailand and ASEAN. A key highlight was a keynote address by the Chairman of the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group, who shared his vision for the future of Islamic finance, emphasizing strong governance, institutional integrity, and sustainable development.

data.title: ONE Championship: Haggerty eyes Muay Thai title return ahead of Akimoto defence
data.description: British champion Jonathan Haggerty wants to reclaim ONE Championship’s bantamweight Muay Thai title if he comes through Saturday’s kickboxing defence against Japanese challenger Hiroki Akimoto in Tokyo.
